games.title: One Brain Cell
games.description: Three departments control one Mike and an oversized sofa. Share a keyboard, fill missing roles with AI, or invite friends into an online room.
games.controls: Keyboard or touch; solo, local or online rooms

games.title: Trust Me, Bro
games.description: One walker, one overconfident navigator, and three increasingly unfortunate compasses. Follow the radio or pass the map to a friend.
games.controls: Keyboard or touch; solo or same-device co-op

games.title: Friend Patch Notes
games.description: Write absurd buffs for Mike, Torin, Jonah and Grant, then watch a five-round battle against their patched clones.

games.title: Airport Impostor
games.description: One impostor among thirty travelers. Complete secret errands or watch the crowd and make your three inspections count.
games.controls: Keyboard, mouse or touch; solo or local two-player

games.title: Group Chat Court
games.description: Present ridiculous evidence, make your argument, and trust a deeply unqualified friend jury. Three cases. Zero legal authority.
games.controls: Mouse, touch or keyboard; solo or same-device hotseat

games.title: Friend Market
games.description: Buy a goofy friend roster, stack their talents, and survive five market closes. All money is imaginary.

games.title: Server Kart
games.description: Everybody drives Mike. Race the group chat, drift through the nonsense, and try not to pay the cheese tax.

games.title: Don't Spill the Soup
games.description: One full bowl. A short walk. A very unhelpful cat. Get as much soup to the table as you can.

games.title: One More Person
games.description: Everyone insists they can fit. Pack the passengers, mind the doorway, and see if the doors will close.

games.title: The Fold
games.description: Enter a hand-drawn library as a nameless apprentice. Invent spells for 2 HP, choose relic paths, and face guardians that learn your magic.
games.controls: Mouse, touch, or keyboard · turn-based rune magic
